definitions.explanation: Describes someone with an outgoing, bright, and energetic personality. Suggests a naturally positive disposition and engaging manner.

examples.japanese: {快活|かいかつ}な⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{快活|かいかつ}で⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{好|す}かれる→好く：30762_suku⟧。
examples.english: She is cheerful and liked by everyone.

examples.japanese: {快活|かいかつ}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ムード→ムード：11160_muudo⟧⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧だ。
examples.english: With his vivacious personality, he is the mood maker of the workplace.

notes:
ADJECTIVE TYPE: Na-adjective. Uses な before nouns: {快活|かいかつ}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧.

NUANCE: {快活|かいかつ} describes a bright, outgoing personality with natural energy and positivity. It's a straightforward compliment suggesting someone who is fun to be around.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {快活|かいかつ}な⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧ (cheerful smile)
- {快活|かいかつ}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧ (lively personality)
- {快活|かいかつ}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (cheerful person)
- {快活|かいかつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧ (to speak vivaciously)
